input:
If ā and b̄ are two unit vectors such that ā + 2b̄ and 5ā - 4b̄ are perpendicular to each other, then the angle between ā and b̄ is

Options:
A. (π/4)
B. (π/3)
C. cos⁻¹(1/3)
D. cos⁻¹(2/7)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the angle θ between unit vectors ā and b̄ given that (ā + 2b̄) ⊥ (5ā - 4b̄).

given_information.to_find: Angle θ between ā and b̄

phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Expand the dot product (ā + 2b̄) · (5ā - 4b̄) = 0, substitute |ā| = 1 and |b̄| = 1, and solve for cos θ.

key_concepts: Perpendicularity condition: u ⊥ v ⇒ u · v = 0
Dot product definition: ā · b̄ = |ā||b̄| cos θ = cos θ

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Expand the dot product equation, set to 0, use unit vector magnitudes to find cos θ, then find θ = π/3.
